not_fixed_by_design.W2-B2-R04: Cash Flow Statement reads only finance_journal_entries and no payment capture posts a cash journal. Closing it means deciding where and when a collection posts to the cash ledger and which account it faces — a double-entry design decision.
not_fixed_by_design.W2-B4-M06: A caller-supplied boolean lifts the quiet-hours bar for a bulk run. The override is now audited; what it may legitimately cover is a marketing/compliance decision.
not_fixed_by_design.W2-B2-R01 / W2-B3-C01 / W2-B3-C07: Phone and name are masked; email, home address and staff internal notes are not. The platform defines only maskPhone and maskName, and an associate arranging a home service needs the address.
not_fixed_by_design.W2-B4-M04: service-media issues no upload grant, where the sibling proof libraries mint an HMAC'd single-use token. A design decision about how that route obtains storage.
not_fixed_by_design.W2-B3-C09: The subscription reminder generator serves two rules and is skipped only when both are inactive.
